name: task-anchor
description: Keep the current explicitly started task across Codex context compactions.

interface.shortDescription: Start a task and restore it after compaction.
interface.longDescription: Each explicit invocation creates a new task, supersedes prior tasks in the same conversation, and restores only the current active task after compaction. Users can explicitly end the current task when it is complete.
defaultPrompt: 使用 $task-anchor 锚定当前任务，并开始执行。
